versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02083 In case of sending an I-PDU with ComTxModeMode DIRECT or MIXED and ComTx- ModeNumberOfRepetitions greater than 0, the AUTOSAR COM module shall call PduR_ComTransmit periodically, with period ComTxModeRepetitionPeriod until ComTxModeNumberOfRepetitions plus one successful confirmations for this send- request are received.
